fields.area: Waters of Heron Bay from the Causeway to Bayou Sara Point, including tributaries up to the head of tide
fields.reason: A release of about 4,200 barrels of diesel at Pelican Point Terminal may contaminate seafood. The closure is precautionary until sampling shows the catch is safe.
restrictions: No commercial or recreational harvest of finfish, shrimp, crab or oysters in the area.
Vessels may transit the area but must not stop to fish.
Persons holding catch from the area after the effective time must not sell or serve it.
fields.lifting: Reopening follows the sampling plan: the closure ends when tissue samples from three consecutive collections are below the state action level, by a new order.
